message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - "test-me-*"

  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "*"

# Cancel running jobs for the same workflow and branch.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:

  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - name: Build and Check Package
      uses: hynek/build-and-inspect-python-package@v2.18

  test:

    needs: [package]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        tox_env:
          - "py310-pytestmin"
          - "py310-pytestlatest"
          - "py311-pytestlatest"
          - "py311-pytestmain"
          - "py312-pytestlatest"
          - "py313-pytestlatest"
          - "py314-pytestlatest"
          - "py310-psutil"
          - "py310-setproctitle"

        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - tox_env: "py310-pytestmin"
            python: "3.10"
          - tox_env: "py310-pytestlatest"
            python: "3.10"
          - tox_env: "py311-pytestlatest"
            python: "3.11"
          - tox_env: "py311-pytestmain"
            python: "3.11"
          - tox_env: "py312-pytestlatest"
            python: "3.12"
          - tox_env: "py313-pytestlatest"
            python: "3.13"
          - tox_env: "py314-pytestlatest"
            python: "~3.14.0-0"
          - tox_env: "py310-psutil"
            python: "3.10"
          - tox_env: "py310-setproctitle"
            python: "3.10"

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        # Needed to fetch tags, which are required by setuptools-scm.
        fetch-depth: 0

    - name: Download Package
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
      with:
        name: Packages
        path: dist

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v7
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}

    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

    - name: Install tox
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install tox

    - name: Test
      shell: bash
      run: |
        tox run -e ${{ matrix.tox_env }} --installpkg "$(find dist/*.whl)"",
  "rationale": "Add a pip dependency cache to the test job so downloaded packages are reused across runs instead of refetched each time. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) and the experiment example showing actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml. Prerequisites are met: pyproject.toml exists as the dependency input, and the job repeatedly runs pip install. All existing build/test steps, matrix coverage, required checks, and permissions are preserved; no steps are removed and no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
